labeler: AI reviewer (Claude), a session separate from the one that wrote the rules. Not yet spot-checked by the maintainer.
method: 20 marketplace repositories not used in rounds 1 or 2. Each was fetched at its pinned commit and read, never executed. Every finding location was checked against the source line, then judged by rule. Labels as in earlier rounds.
limits: One reviewer, one pass, 20 repositories. "missed" comes from reading installers and grepping for common patterns, not an exhaustive search, so no recall figure can be derived.
regression: All 34 OA-SH-002 findings come from one repository and were introduced by PR #13. The same repository scanned at 0d5b07d (before PR #8) and at 516edc9 (after PR #8, before PR #13) produces no OA-SH-002 finding.

missed.what: A Python helper uses pkexec to write /etc/keyd/hancore-ctrl-swap.conf, enables and restarts the keyd system service, and clones and builds keyd from source with make. These are root-level system changes. The report verdict is "minor-notes" because Python logic is not analysed.

The installer copies a Lua file into ~/.config/hypr and adds a require line to ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua, which Hyprland loads at session start. It asks first and makes a backup, but the change to the session config is not reported; only README findings were produced for this repository.
